description: GEO-01B entrances and service-area geometry: design challenge and exact-diff review

accessibility_inferred.instructions: An accessibility fact (step-free, lift, accessible toilet or parking, or an ACCESSIBLE entrance) could be claimed without an attested or verified human/provider source, for example from an external dataset, imagery, 3D or AI.

criteria.true: Some accessibility claim can come from an unattested or inferred source
criteria.false: Accessibility claims need attested or verified sources and external data stays UNKNOWN

availability_inferred.instructions: Being inside a service area could be read or returned as meaning that care or an appointment is available.

criteria.true: A service area can imply availability
criteria.false: Service areas are geometry facts only and never imply availability

invalid_geometry.instructions: An invalid polygon (unclosed, self-intersecting, wrong SRID or type, out-of-range, oversized) could be stored or used.

criteria.false: All are refused in code and database

cross_scope_link.instructions: An entrance or service area could link to another tenant's or another branch's branch or service, or a supersession could cross branches.

criteria.true: Some cross-tenant or cross-branch link is possible
criteria.false: Composite keys keep every link inside one tenant and branch

stale_entrance_shown.instructions: An inactive, superseded or expired entrance could still be treated as a current entrance.

criteria.false: Only active, unexpired chain heads are current

residual_risk.instructions: How much risk remains in this design?
